Enzo Maresca tinkers his way to nervy Man City win

📅 23 Aug 2026 | ⏱️ 26 min read (5180 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~26 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Few in elite sport have the luxury of managing their own endings as Pep Guardiola did at Manchester City, yet no one can ever fully control a beginning.
  • The narrative focus has been the impossibility of filling the personality void Guardiola leaves at a club sculpted in his image.
  • All of that can wait after this victory against Bournemouth, which quietened some of the alarms from last weekend’s 3-0 defeat by Arsenal in Cardiff.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Few in elite sport have the luxury of managing their own endings as Pep Guardiola did at Manchester City, yet no one can ever fully control a beginning. Enzo Maresca’s City started their Premier League season with a win, in the end, but three points masked the scale of the job he faces.

The narrative focus has been the impossibility of filling the personality void Guardiola leaves at a club sculpted in his image. That macro reading overlooks the number of distinct issues with City that Maresca must fix. A new midfield has to be recruited then blooded, a jittery defence needs settling down, and Phil Foden clearly requires help to recover the form which made him Premier League player of the year as recently as 2024.

All of that can wait after this victory against Bournemouth, which quietened some of the alarms from last weekend’s 3-0 defeat by Arsenal in Cardiff. Josko Gvardiol scored an injury-time winner after City had trailed for most of the match, much of it a sloppy slog for the home side, who went behind in the 26th minute. The introduction of Rayan Cherki for Nico O’Reilly revived some familiar attacking effusiveness.

Industry observers note that A lesser-spotted VAR-aided double celebration capped a tense but ultimately joyful day for Maresca. Marc Guéhi equalised from Cherki’s well-taken corner in the final minutes, then the expanded Etihad Stadium rapturously celebrated Gvardiol’s apparent winner, only to see it flagged offside. Video assistant Paul Howard intervened to show Gvardiol was onside from Cherki’s pass, before City’s fans, players and staff shouted twice as loud for twice as long to salute a morale-boosting victory.

It has been revealed that joško Gvardiol scores in stoppage time! 👊 pic.twitter.com/FrTrfIg3ur.

“It’s the perfect day to be honest,” Maresca said, although he may wish to set his expectations slightly higher. The East Stand which faces the dugouts at the Etihad unfurled a banner before the game welcoming him back to Manchester after his spell as Guardiola’s assistant. “I was very pleased when the game started, to watch the banner at the other side, and I was pleased at the end because we gave them the joy of the three points.”.

His team made a fluid and furious start to Premier League football, suffused with a desire to prove the Community Shield is just a jumped-up friendly. A newly streamlined short-haired Erling Haaland ran with impatience, Elliot Anderson was a sinewy presence in midfield, Foden pulled off a gorgeous flick which led to a shot by Rico Lewis, well saved by Djordje Petrovic.

Sources indicate that maresca’s selection was surprising, with six defenders in his XI, some deployed unexpectedly. Guéhi partnered Anderson in defensive midfield, while their England team-mate O’Reilly was often just behind Haaland in a No 10 role. There was an air of destiny about one O’Reilly run down the left flank in the first half, cruising to the byline and crossing presentably. Haaland was well positioned in the middle, but utterly fluffed his lines. Samson similes on standby, although perhaps he too was short of full match fitness during his early-season visit from the Philistines?

Momentum shifted after Haaland’s miss, and Bournemouth took the lead when an innocuous high ball flummoxed Abdukodir Khusanov and Rúben Dias. They both pursued it, neither could make decisive contact and it left Evanilson on the ball with space to manufacture an unmissable cross for Marcus Tavernier.

Marcus Tavernier fires Bournemouth ahead against Manchester City! 💥 pic.twitter.com/lSyNRfrTlc.

Recent findings suggest that marco Rose, their latest manager, is facing a similarly daunting task to Maresca in living up to a predecessor who led Bournemouth to their highest-ever league finish and European football. “How the game went, it was quite unlucky to lose,” he said. “We had two situations, one corner kick and one attacking when we defended too passive, and that’s why we lost.”.

His team demonstrated an appealing coiled-spring quality after weathering the early City onslaught. They have players of class with the ever lively Tavernier, new signing António Silva seamlessly replacing Marcos Senesi at centre-back and silky Alex Scott, the Guernsey Grealish, whose current standing has now overtaken the man who gave him his nickname.

They could not hang on here though, with Guéhi atoning for a free header planted wide with his day-saving equaliser. Cherki’s corner was nodded in from around the six-yard line then, with the game in the balance, the Frenchman provided another, thanks in part to the semi-automated gods smiling on Gvardiol and his new manager.

According to recent reports, "That is an EXTRAORDINARY miss!" 🫣Marc Guehi misses a golden opportunity to equalise for Manchester City! pic.twitter.com/Jl96MMmQeP.

No mistakes this time from Marc Guehi 😤 pic.twitter.com/xlCJXWUzz6.

City will need more, especially in midfield. Anderson at his best can cover the ground and roles of two men, which is just as well as City await reinforcements. The incoming Ayyoub Bouaddi will help, but it is a substantial ask for an 18-year-old to fill a spot vacated by a Ballon d’Or winner. Maresca was asked after the match about finding a “fresh Rodri” and deadpanned “Marc Guéhi”, who played acceptably, but is probably not a long-term solution.

There was a jadedness at times from City, which is not a great way to start the season, although they will surely improve with a bolstered squad and fitness levels. Maresca said “four or five” of his players who returned late from the World Cup are still effectively in pre-season training, including Haaland and Anderson.

Of course City are not the finished article, what team are one game into a latest season? While there is a vast gap from this performance to their best, it was still impressive to smuggle three points from zero with six minutes left to play. Guardiola’s influence will be hard to shake, but that need not be a negative.

Marc Guéhi: Central Midfield Edition pic.twitter.com/ViBZqOroB2.

The Maresca era begins with the most dramatic of wins. City were trailing 1-0 at 84 minutes, but somehow managed to turn it around.

By Seye Omidiora | 25 Nov 2026 01:48, Last updated: 25 Nov 2026 01:51.

Real Madrid midfielder Jude Bellingham has brushed off Ballon d'Or talk after inspiring his side to a commanding 5-1 Champions League comeback victory over PSV Eindhoven.

The 23-year-old England international started Tuesday's league phase encounter at the Santiago Bernabeu on the bench as Jose Mourinho opted to manage his workload following recent fatigue.

With Los Blancos trailing 1-0 at the interval to an Ivan Perisic penalty, Mourinho summoned Bellingham at half-time and the substitute immediately transformed the contest.

After Federico Valverde restored parity five minutes into the second period, Bellingham put the hosts ahead on the hour mark with a sensational strike before later setting up Vinicius Junior's late fifth.

Bellingham's decisive go-ahead strike immediately drew comparisons to club icon Zinedine Zidane, whose famous number five shirt the Englishman wears in the Spanish capital.

Collecting the ball on the edge of the penalty area, the midfielder flicked it up with his first touch before slicing an audacious outside-of-the-boot volley inside the far post.

Speaking after the final whistle, Bellingham admitted the acrobatic effort stood above anything else he has produced in his career so far.

"I think this was the best goal of my life," Bellingham remarked, as reported by Fabrizio Romano.

@FabrizioRomano That was a prefect goal https://t.co/4j8kLOdUMX.

Teammate Bernardo Silva echoed the widespread awe inside the stadium, describing the strike as "one of those moments when you just go, 'Wow!'".

Bellingham's dazzling second-half appearance prompted Mourinho to reiterate his belief that omitting the midfielder from the top 10 at this year's Ballon d'Or ceremony was jarring.

The Portuguese tactician also conceded that leaving his talisman out of the starting lineup had backfired, admitting he had mistakenly believed Madrid could win without him.

When pressed on the prestigious individual accolade afterwards, however, Bellingham made it clear that collective silverware remains his sole obsession.

"Ballon d'Or? I do not care," he declared. "It's for journalists, not for me. I want to win all titles with Real Madrid.".

Having helped Los Blancos preserve their 100% start in the Champions League league phase, Bellingham will now look to carry his sparkling form back into La Liga action this weekend.

Mourinho's team are three points off Barcelona in the La Liga table ahead of their next match against Alaves.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Seye Omidiora | 25 Nov 2026 02:12.

Argentine giants Boca Juniors are reportedly keen to bring Tottenham Hotspur midfielder Rodrigo Bentancur back to Buenos Aires as they prepare for next year's Copa Libertadores.

While funding a deal for the 29-year-old Uruguay international would normally prove difficult, the potential sale of highly rated youngster Milton Delgado could hand Boca the financial firepower required.

Aston Villa are among a host of English clubs tracking the 21-year-old defensive midfielder, meaning a winter raid from Unai Emery's side could directly threaten Tottenham's midfield depth.

According to Argentine outlets El Crack Deportivo and El Intransigente via Sport Witness, Boca president Juan Roman Riquelme has already started preliminary work on re-signing Bentancur.

Riquelme views the Spurs stalwart as his preferred candidate to replace Delgado should the academy graduate depart La Bombonera in the coming months.

Bentancur progressed through Boca's youth ranks before earning a switch to Juventus in 2017 and is seen as the ideal experienced presence to anchor their upcoming continental campaign.

The South American outfit plan to reinvest the proceeds from Delgado's prospective transfer straight into a formal approach for their former player.

Delgado's stock has risen even further after he played the full 90 minutes in Boca's 2-0 Copa Sudamericana final triumph over Atletico Mineiro on Saturday.

Villa are reportedly preparing a formal January offer for Delgado after scouting the 21-year-old extensively across the past six months.

However, Emery's side are far from alone in the race, with Chelsea, Bournemouth, Brighton and West Ham United all linked with the youngster.

Boca are believed to have previously rejected a £7.5m bid from MLS side Atlanta United back in August, around the same time Chelsea and Bournemouth lodged initial enquiries for the young midfielder, who is valued at €10m (£8.4m) by Transfermarkt.

Portuguese outfit Porto are also believed to be monitoring developments from Europe, leaving Riquelme in a strong position to command a substantial fee if a bidding war erupts.

Even if Boca secure the necessary funds, convincing Bentancur to leave North London could prove complicated given that he signed a fresh long-term contract with Tottenham in October 2025 and has spent almost a decade competing at the top level in Europe.

By LEWIS BROWNING, SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 16:03 EST, 23 November 2026 | Updated: 16:05 EST, 23 November 2026.

Former Manchester United midfielder Paul Scholes has become the latest ex-Red Devil to tear into the club's defence, criticising Leny Yoro following his red card in his side's 4-0 defeat by Liverpool.

Yoro was sent off less than eight minutes into United's clash with their rivals at Anfield on Sunday, tripping Alexander Isak as he ran in on goal after an error from Matthijs de Ligt.

He has had a mixed time of things since his £52million move to Old Trafford in 2024, though has been playing in a leaky United defence that has conceded 23 goals in 11 Premier League matches this season – with only Crystal Palace conceding more.

Several different members of United's defence have come under fire this season, and, on Monday, it was the turn of Yoro.

'The Premier League at this minute just looks a little bit too much for him,' Scholes said on The Good, The Bad and The Football, sponsored by Midnite.

Industry observers note that he added: 'You know what, he’s come in to a really bad setup defensively now. I think they also made the point yesterday if he went in next to (Virgil) Van Dijk he might look a little bit better but he doesn’t look Premier League level. He looks like a rabbit in the headlights.'.

Paul Scholes (pictured) has suggested Leny Yoro is not yet ready for the Premier League.

Yoro was sent off in the opening minutes of Manchester United's 4-0 defeat by Liverpool.

In a recent development, fellow former United midfielder Nicky Butt, who played alongside Scholes for United between 1994 and 2004, added: 'If that’s Man United in our day, he’s on loan like a Jonny Evans or a John O’Shea. He’s a great talent that will come good.'.

Scholes, though, wasn't having any of it.

Sources indicate that he replied: 'I’m not sure how much of a great talent he is. I think he has shown a little bit of a sign in the France squad but every time I’ve seen him he doesn’t look at the races. Everything’s happening around him and he’s just a bit, oh, what do I do?'.

United have also faced criticism for their apparent lack of running this season, with eyebrows raised when Youri Tielemans stated in the summer that they didn't do much prior to the campaign getting under way.

The club rank 17th for distance covered in the top flight this season, with Liverpool, Brentford and Everton below them. The latter two will almost certainly pass them though after their game on Monday.

That, according to Butt, is down to the players.

'We’ve had our say about the players and they’re just not good enough,' he stated. 'It is the most unathletic team I’ve ever seen in Man United.

Recent findings suggest that 'I’m going to go through a team and I’m trying to be as honest as I can. Forget the quality for right now. For me, physicality-wise, if you go through a team, the right back, he’s physically OK, but he’s not amazing. De Ligt or Harry, whoever he’s going to play in there, physically not great. Martinez for me is physically not great. You got Yoro who will physically come good.

Nicky Butt (pictured), meanwhile, has criticised the physical ability of many of United's players.

'Then I go on to the midfield, none of them are physically good enough. Kobbie can get about the pitch 15-20 yards, but he’s not box to box. Noted that numerous times. He’s got a lot of talent. He’s got a lot of things going for him. I think he’s a top player. He ain’t got the legs. He needs to have legs around him but his legs around him at the minute are Bruno and Tielemans - and they can’t run around.

'Look at Mbeumo, I think he’s OK but he’s not going to blow anybody away. I think Cunha can run. So then you look at the whole squad and you’re saying three players can run.

'What I’m getting at there, and it sounds like I’m being a draconian but what you have to do first and foremost when you go to Anfield is to be able to compete physically and they can’t so they have no chance.'.

Industry observers note that il pari di Manchester ha dato qualche certezza in più al Napoli e ora gli azzurri sono più vicini all’obiettivo Playoff, priorità più volte indicata dalla società e dal tecnico Massimiliano Allegri. Il Napoli ha 4 punti in classifica e con 3 gare piuttosto alla portata la sensazione è che la qualificazione ai Playoff sia ora più vicina.

Sette punti in tre partite per avere la certezza, ora non serve solo vincere in tutte le gare ma gli azzurri hanno un jolly, da giocarsi probabilmente nella sfida contro il club belga del Club Brugge.

It has been revealed that nelle prossime tre sfide il Napoli di Massimiliano Allegri affronterà Club Brugge e Viking in casa e gli azeri del Sabah in trasferta, tutte squadre contro il quale il Napoli parte sulla carta favorito. Gli azzurri devono arrivare almeno a 10 punti, ma possono chiudere qualsiasi discorso a quota 11 punti e quindi 7 punti almeno in tre partite.

Un pari casalingo contro il Brugge e due vittorie contro Viking e Sabah chiuderebbero il discorso e gli azzurri si garantirebbero i Playoff con la possibilità di andare agli Ottavi di finale.

Newcastle and Liverpool serve up thrilling tribute to Kevin Keegan

📅 23 Aug 2026 | ⏱️ 32 min read (6490 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Co

⏱️ ~32 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that it had to end that way, didn’t it?
  • Newcastle versus Liverpool became the Premier League’s most dramatic fixture when Kevin Keegan was manager here and, on the afternoon they flocked to the “cathedral on the hill” to pay tribute to the late, great superstar, we were treated to a contest that was in keeping with his narrative.
  • Liverpool operating with the discipline of a basketball team undoubtedly helped, and we can examine those gaping chasms soon enough, but the poignancy of seeing Matthias Jaissle looking as bereft as Keegan at Anfield 30 years ago at the final whistle was impossible to ignore.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that it had to end that way, didn’t it? A last-minute goal, a sense of what might have been and a helter-skelter contest that will take days to decipher.

Newcastle versus Liverpool became the Premier League’s most dramatic fixture when Kevin Keegan was manager here and, on the afternoon they flocked to the “cathedral on the hill” to pay tribute to the late, great superstar, we were treated to a contest that was in keeping with his narrative.

Liverpool operating with the discipline of a basketball team undoubtedly helped, and we can examine those gaping chasms soon enough, but the poignancy of seeing Matthias Jaissle looking as bereft as Keegan at Anfield 30 years ago at the final whistle was impossible to ignore.

It has been revealed that really, the German’s first match in charge of Newcastle should have ended with three points. His team are a work in progress – rich in youthful exuberance though prone to lapses – but how they fought, ran and worked to give the locals the result they wanted.

In a recent development, they were almost at the finish line, seconds away from beating Liverpool here for the first time since December 2015, but then Lewis Hall ran into Victor Muñoz, sending the Spanish substitute sprawling, and Stuart Attwell pointed to the penalty spot. Dominik Szoboszlai inflicted maximum damage.

Dominik Szoboszlai equalises from the spot in the 99th minute! 🤯 pic.twitter.com/0Ag9WitqHt.

In a recent development, “I have clear thoughts,” Jaissle remarked quietly, as he was asked to reflect on the day-wrecking decision. “I guess you call it a soft penalty here. If you give it, you need to give a lot during this match and a lot during the season. I don’t know if it that is good for football.”.

Here was the third time in four seasons Liverpool had scored in injury time in front of the Leazes Stand, after Darwin Núñez (2023) and Rio Ngumoha (2025), and their eighth goal beyond the 90th minute in collisions with Newcastle is a Premier League record against the same opponents.

No wonder he was stunned. Jaissle had spent idle moments in the build-up thinking about what might happen if Newcastle scored an early goal and, much to his delight, fantasy became reality in the most thrilling fashion. On this emotional afternoon, it was fitting the hosts scored first.

In a recent development, one of Keegan’s great early wins as Newcastle manager was in November 1993, when his team blew away Liverpool in the snow and Andy Cole scored a first-half hat-trick. His first goal that day came after five minutes and, by happy coincidence, the clock stopped at that moment for Anthony Elanga, too.

How Liverpool went from having a chance of their own to conceding 20 seconds later is something Andoni Iraola will have to address quickly, but that is what happened: Ryan Gravenberch should have shot, instead he passed and Amar Dedic intervened, his interception finding Will Osula.

Industry observers note that off Osula galloped, Liverpool’s defenders looking leaden-footed as they gave pursuit, and he ushered Elanga into open space. Once he was in the clear, he was not for catching and his shot was perfectly placed beyond Alisson Becker.

Industry observers note that an electric start! Anthony Elanga gives Newcastle the lead inside 5 minutes! ⚡️ pic.twitter.com/8DYYFJ9i6F.

Sources indicate that as Elanga was mobbed, the recriminations started. Fingers pointed at each other, Iraola spun around in dismay. Liverpool were easy to play against last season – Iraola’s Bournemouth had scored two identical goals against them on the opening day 12 months ago – and old habits die hard.

Recent findings suggest that “We should finish the play,” Iraola conceded. “We created a great chance. We are on the edge of the box and have a clear opening to shoot and we decide not to. We don’t finish it properly and then you have to give credit to Elanga, who wins the race.”.

What could Liverpool offer in response? The answer before the interval was nothing, other than a shot from Florian Wirtz that was well saved by Lukas Hornicek. The first half was wretched and it was difficult to see what had changed from the final throes of Arne Slot.

Recent findings suggest that this, to be clear, is no criticism of Iraola, more a spotlight on players who need to step up. They did that momentarily in the second period, when Cody Gakpo equalised. He was afforded too much time by Newcastle’s defence but, still, his finish from 20 yards was super, zipping beyond Hornicek.

Cody Gakpo with a fine finish to equalise for Liverpool! 🎯 pic.twitter.com/cfDQWbES2v.

In a recent development, but parity was secured for less than two minutes before Newcastle scored a near-carbon-copy second goal, another counter-attack – this was one led by the outstanding Yoane Wissa – ending with substitute Joe Willock finding a corner of Alisson’s net. Again the inquests followed.

"Wow!"Joe Willock restores Newcastle's advantage almost instantly with an exceptional finish! 🤯 pic.twitter.com/8IKPUgqapK.

“We had the numbers to defend it better,” Iraola said. “It’s not like they caught us by surprise, but we didn’t defend it properly. We should compete for the first ball and probably make a foul, be a little more aggressive as we had the numbers to defend it.

“You don’t want to concede transitions and we’d been preparing them in the week for transitions.”.

Why they didn’t follow the plan that had been set is something that Iraola must address, but he will be relieved that the days spent this week are not dissecting a defeat, as Wissa should have wrapped up the contest, only for Alisson to make a brilliant save to thwart the Congolese striker.

Those missed chances should not have mattered but in the final throes, Hall misjudged the angle Muñoz attacked him from, he got his challenge wrong and, after a pause, Attwell pointed to the spot. Given the agony Liverpool have inflicted, the outcome was as clear as black and white.

Sources indicate that “We scored at the end, so you have a better taste,” Iraola said. “Before the game, we wouldn’t have signed for this result. It’s a reward. It’s only a point, but at least it’s something that’s deserved.”.

Plenty would contest his conclusion. Liverpool got away with it – and Iraola is about to find the hard work is only just beginning.

A really soft one, if you give that, they’ll be more in the future, I’m not a fan of that.

Their heads are a little down but we know we had many challenges, we’re in a huge transition phase at the moment.

It’s a brave project but I like the challenge, working with young lads, they were tired. Lewis Miley just came back from an injury but they did an amazing job and it’s just about getting adapted to the league.

Recent findings suggest that the crowd here is unbelievable and the quality. Every change can be decisive and it’s something I really enjoy. We’re clear in our approach and you can adjust in the game if you plan ahead.

It’s not the result you want, but scoring in the last minute gives us a better feeling. I value that the players never gave up. I’m sure we had more chances, it’s unfair they’re winning very early and overall, I think we’ve had the better chances.

Industry observers note that we were probably in the first half not finishing anything, we had a lot of balls on the edge but we needed to shoot. We don’t finish play and then they win on the counter-attack.

The players coming from the bench gave us energy and you can feel the way we want to play.

Overall, we played a lot in their half and had good moments and phases on the ball. The first goal was more difficult to defend, Anthony Elanga is a fast player. The second, I think we had the numbers but sometimes you have to finish the play and try and win the ball.

Recent findings suggest that what a special club, what a special man, that’s why we gave him a major credit. The fans were unbelievable today. I think we gave them so much back today and that’s what we need to give them all season.

In a recent development, we know we needed to give the fans something after this period so that’s why we tried to start fast. The fans pushed us until the end.

It has been revealed that it was my best [performance for Newcastle] so far. Upcoming manager, new role. I’m so pleased to be here. I hope today I demonstrated I’m really happy.

Recent findings suggest that it’s rough, especially 30 seconds before the end of the game, but that’s a huge step for us. That’s the mentality we need to have through the season. The manager came three weeks ago and gave us a lot of information. Now we show on the pitch we are ready for the season. We needed this win to make a statement but in the end we draw. We have so much to work on.

To be honest, I didn’t even hear the referee’s whistle. I had to look at him if I can go. I was practising a lot during the pre-season. We didn’t have any penalties during games, but in training. We need to take the positivity of the first game and move on.

Recent findings suggest that more than 50,000 fans in the stadium against you. You can’t hear your own voice. That’s why I love football and that’s why I am doing it.

It has been revealed that to come here is always tough. Everybody knows the [Newcastle] fans are unbelievable. They have a great team and a manager - new but he has proven himself in many other clubs. But we were prepared and we needed to be closer to each other under a new manager as well. We needed to know what was going on in the game. It’s a good thing coming back into the game after 2-1 down.

It has been revealed that if I am honest, we should have won. But that’s football. You don’t win easy in the Premier League - doesn’t matter who you play against. We have to be aware of that and we need to take care in the next game.

🗣️ "It's knee on knee, it's a foul"Micah Richards and Daniel Sturridge analyse Lewis Hall's foul which led to Liverpool's late penalty. pic.twitter.com/NRw406sTcZ.

Sources indicate that 14 - Liverpool remain unbeaten on MD1 in the Premier League in each of the last 14 seasons (since 2013-14), the longest active run in the competition.Spirited. pic.twitter.com/3rluUnSBhu.

I think they did the right thing, easy to say now of course, by not giving Isak the penalty. There is enough pressure on in the 96th minute without all that would have entailed. Nor was Isak having the best of games.

A familiar feeling after last season. Newcastle concede a last kick of the game penalty. Should have held on for the win. It was a soft penalty, Hall dangled out a knee rather than a leg and Munoz made sure he ran into it. But as soon as it's given on the field never going to be….

It has been revealed that the points are shared, and Lewis Hall has his hands on his knees. Jaissle protests with the officials. This was a stirring home performance from Newcastle which should build confidence for the season ahead. An irrepressible showing from Wissa was the biggest positive. Iraola will be pleased to get back on the coach with a draw after what was quite a ragged Liverpool performance, their midfield balance looked off.

What a magnificent penalty from Szoboszlai, Hornicek had no chance, and Liverpool have surely snatched a point.

According to recent reports, dominik Szoboszlai equalises from the spot in the 99th minute! 🤯 pic.twitter.com/0Ag9WitqHt.

What theatre that would be... Gakpo has the ball in his hands. But no, it’s going to be Szoboszlai.

With the last kick of the game, practically. Kerkez introduced the ball forward, Van Dijk competed for a header, Munoz pounced on the seconds, and his pace carried enough threat to prompt Hall to step across the winger and make contact with his knee.

It has been revealed that #NEWLIV – 90+6' The referee's call of penalty for the challenge by Hall on Muñoz was checked and confirmed by VAR. REF: "He doesn't play the ball. He makes clear contact". VAR: "It's knee into thigh contact. Confirming the on-field decision of penalty".

So, so poor from Frimpong who hesitates to put a cross in, takes a couple of unconvincing touches, and then commits a foul. Mac Allister. Wissa receives a standing ovation, replaced by Schar.

Gakpo runs down a blind alley, and it is another blunt Liverpool attack. Time running out for them now.

Liverpool corner, won by Lewis Koumas who lacked support but his cross deflects behind.

Recent findings suggest that hornicek palms away Szoboszlai’s delivery. This has been strong Premier League debut from the goalkeeper.

Newcastle have a throw deep in Liverpool territory after more good work from Wissa, and chaotic defending from Liverpool. Atwell has booked Gakpo for an earlier foul on Wissa.

Per festeggiare il Natale, quest'anno la Lazio ha pensato ad un evento differente rispetto alla consueta cena, che si svolgeva di solito a Spazio Novecento.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Industry observers note that come si legge dal comunicato della Lazio con la lettera di Lotito riportata dal Corriere dello Sport, quest'anno l'invito per i tesserati della Lazio è per sabato 19 dicembre alle 15.00 per celebrare la messa di Natale. Inoltre verranno destinate risorse al sostegno di alcune realtà della nostra città che ogni giorno si impegnano ad aiutare le persone e le famiglie che vivono situazioni di difficoltà”.

In a recent development, A tutti i tesserati, dipendenti e collaboratori della S.S. Lazio.

il Natale è soprattutto un momento per stare insieme, ritrovarsi e ricordare ciò che conta davvero.

Quest’anno abbiamo pensato di scambiarci gli auguri in un modo diverso, più semplice, ma forse proprio per questo ancora più significativo.

Sabato 19 dicembre 2026, alle ore 15:00, ci ritroveremo nella parrocchia San Tommaso Moro, di Don Gabriele, nel quartiere San Lorenzo a Roma, per celebrare insieme la Santa Messa di Natale. Vorrei che fosse un momento per tutti noi, per sentirci parte di una comunità che ogni giorno condivide lavoro, impegno, responsabilità, gioie e difficoltà. Perché la Lazio, prima ancora di essere una società sportiva, è fatta di persone.

Quest’anno abbiamo anche deciso di vivere lo spirito del Natale attraverso un gesto concreto di solidarietà, destinando risorse al sostegno di alcune realtà della nostra città che ogni giorno si impegnano ad aiutare le persone e le famiglie che vivono situazioni di difficoltà.

Ci sono tante persone e tante famiglie che stanno attraversando momenti complicati. Credo che il modo migliore per vivere lo spirito del Natale sia anche quello di pensare a loro, rinunciando a qualcosa per noi per poter offrire qualcosa agli altri.

Non sarà un gesto che risolverà tutti i problemi, ma sarà il nostro modo di esserci, concretamente.

Sources indicate that mi piacerebbe davvero che il 19 dicembre fossimo tutti presenti. Non per un appuntamento formale, ma per il piacere di ritrovarci, guardarci negli occhi, scambiarci gli auguri e condividere un momento che appartiene a tutti noi.

Perché essere una comunità significa anche questo: sentirsi parte di qualcosa e sapere che, insieme, possiamo fare del bene.

Vi aspetto e, fin da ora, auguro a voi e alle vostre famiglie un Natale sereno, con l’auspicio che il nuovo anno possa portare salute, pace e soddisfazioni.

In a recent development, claudio Lotito Presidente S.S. Lazio.

Parrocchia San Tommaso Moro Via dei Ramni, 40, 00185 Roma (angolo Via dei Marrucini).

After the full-time whistle, Rabiot spoke alongside Ramos to both Sky and DAZN, offering his thoughts on what was a very successful evening in front of all the fans at San Siro. His words are via MilanNews.

Are you starting to build a good identity?

“Our problem is that we have to be focused for 90 minutes. We did well today, even though we conceded a bit at the end, but that’s normal. As I said, we’re growing as a team: the quality of our play, the team spirit, the sacrifice for 90 minutes, and everyone.

Sources indicate that “Gonçalo is the first to do a lot. Today I saw he had a bit of pain in his thigh. I know he’s a very key player for us, and we have a lot of games: I even asked the coach to let him rest a bit. But everyone’s attitude was great today, and we have to keep it up.

“In these last few games, when we play like this, when we’re so focused and manage to do what we work towards in training, I think we’re all enjoying ourselves, even tonight. We created a lot, we scored a lot of goals. What we have to focus on is enjoying playing together.”.

Why didn’t you shoot before the first goal?

“I wanted Pulisic to score, but the defender came back quickly. It’s true that I could have shot, but I get more pleasure from providing an assist than from scoring. But I did the assist afterwards.”.

“He does a great job. Not everyone understands it, but he does an incredible job. When we get in and score, it’s also credit to us. Then we feel happy when he scores, also because it gives him confidence. Good for us and for him, for everyone.”.

By Seye Omidiora | 25 Nov 2026 02:59.

Serie A duo Como and Napoli are reportedly monitoring Manchester United forward Joshua Zirkzee ahead of the January transfer window.

The 25-year-old Netherlands international has struggled to secure regular playing time under multiple managers since arriving at Old Trafford from Bologna in the summer of 2024.

Zirkzee is yet to make a single Premier League start during the 2026-27 campaign, with all seven of his top-flight outings coming from the substitutes' bench.

After nearly leaving England on Deadline Day, when United rejected an approach from Everton, the attacker could now be set for a winter return to Italian football.

The forward has been earmarked as a possible early departure from Old Trafford under Mauricio Pochettino in January.

According to Sky Sports News, both Italian clubs are exploring a mid-season move but are waiting for clarity on Zirkzee's role under upcoming United head coach Mauricio Pochettino.

Pochettino was only appointed last week and handed the Dutchman a 45-minute second-half cameo during Sunday's chastening 4-0 Premier League defeat at Liverpool.

No formal negotiations have been opened with the Red Devils hierarchy yet as suitors wait to discover whether the Argentine tactician considers the forward surplus to requirements.

Zirkzee has managed two goals across his limited substitute appearances this season, netting against Aston Villa in the league and ironically finding the back of the net against Como in the Champions League last month.

The Dutchman's previous pedigree in Italy, where he earned a spot in the Serie A Team of the Year with Bologna, ensures his stock remains high across the peninsula despite his Old Trafford struggles.

Both interested sides have urgent attacking voids to fill when the winter market opens for business.

Como boss Cesc Fabregas recently confirmed that striker Moise Kean faces several months on the sidelines after aggravating a recurring tibia issue in training.

Meanwhile, Napoli boss Massimiliano Allegri is seeking fresh firepower after Lorenzo Lucca struggled to make an impact following his return from a loan spell at Nottingham Forest.

With United already heavily linked with prolific strikers like Vangelis Pavlidis and Ivan Toney to spearhead Pochettino's rebuild, a January exit could ultimately suit all parties involved.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Axel Clody | 25 Nov 2026 06:28.

In recent seasons, Manu Kone has often been linked with Paris Saint-Germain, but the capital club have never really tried to sign him. The reason behind that choice has been revealed.

A talented French international from the Paris region, Manu Kone seemed to have the ideal profile to join PSG. The Roma midfielder has often been reported on the capital club's shortlist, but PSG have never really tried to recruit him.

The 25-year-old will return to the Parc des Princes on Wednesday at 8pm UK time, for matchday five of the Champions League with the Italian side.

He will have the chance to show the full extent of his talent to Parisian supporters, although it is unlikely that Kone will join the two-time European champions in the short term, according to L'Equipe.

According to recent reports, the sports daily tried to explain the reasons for PSG's choice not to sign the French midfielder. This summer, Paris simply had no desire to recruit another midfielder and wanted to count on their current squad, with its established players such as Vitinha and Joao Neves, and its young gems such as Dro Fernandez and Senny Mayulu.

It has been revealed that paris had an opportunity in the summer of 2024. Before his move to Roma for £15.3m (€18m), the Frenchman was offered to Paris. Some people internally pushed for the capital club to sign this promising and affordable young box-to-box midfielder. Luis Campos has always liked the profile of the former Toulouse player.

Recent findings suggest that however, PSG decided otherwise. 'I do not make all the decisions on my own' - the Paris sporting director said.

L'Equipe concludes that Luis Enrique did not approve the option. The Spanish boss preferred to rely on his Neves-Vitinha-Ruiz trio. Therefore, unless he changes his mind, the Kone option appears to be one to forget in Paris.

While PSG appear to have moved on, Kone has regularly been linked with clubs in England. Chelsea, Liverpool and Manchester United were all credited with interest in the Roma midfielder during the summer transfer window, including on deadline day, according to the Liverpool Echo.

Recent findings suggest that chelsea were noted to still have an interest in late August, with Kone one of several midfielders on their list, according to CaughtOffside. At that stage, the website considered Manchester United effectively out of the race after the signings of Youri Tielemans, Andrey Santos and Carlos Baleba, although that was its own assessment rather than a reported club position.

Recent findings suggest that more recently, Gazzetta dello Sport reported in mid-November that Chelsea could make a move in January. Roma boss Gian Piero Gasperini reportedly vetoed a sale in the final hours of the summer window, and the Italian club are said to value Kone at £47m-£51m (€55m-€60m), compared with the £43m reported in August.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

The stirring of what might yet be a great partnership between Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers, although it will need to be, given some of the chaos that endures at Chelsea.

Recent findings suggest that this was a Premier League game played at a furious pace, and the two former Real Madrid team-mates in charge of the sides will not have seen much of the control all coaches seek. Xabi Alonso’s team eventually won with a goal from each of his attacking triumvirate of Rogers, Palmer and João Pedro – and at times it will have been painful for the newly introduced Chelsea manager.

According to recent reports, that was chiefly the fault of Robert Sánchez, who was embraced afterwards by Alonso, having demonstrated just how damaging a shaky goalkeeper can be to any serious team. Álvaro Arbeloa’s Fulham had their moments – and the best ones were granted to them by Sánchez. At a club that is such a restless trader of footballers, it feels remarkable that Sánchez has endured for so long.

In a recent development, alonso played down the significance of Sánchez’s errors, although he cannot seriously be considering sticking to his mantra of “relax and carry on”. That was, he said, his response to the first-half Sánchez mistake that let in Josh King’s shot for Fulham’s first goal. Sánchez could have done a lot better with Gonzalo García’s goal after the break.

Fulham have equalised against Chelsea thanks to Josh King's low strike 💥 pic.twitter.com/WCLKB7XqeE.

Gonzalo Garcia has scored on his Premier League debut after Robert Sanchez spilled Castagne's shot 🤯 pic.twitter.com/BmP6eqwkuN.

Chelsea have a lot of faith that Mike Penders, the 21-year-old Belgian on the bench for this game, will be their first-choice goalkeeper eventually. The situation seems rather more urgent and with Penders likely to feature against Luton Town on Thursday night in the Carabao Cup it would appear a significant decision is looming for Alonso.

In terms of the Palmer-Rogers axis, this was very promising, although there was no doubting the senior figure in this. Palmer’s ball set João Pedro free in the first minute, the Brazilian lifting a well-judged nudge over Bernd Leno.

"A flying start under Xabi Alonso!" Chelsea lead against Fulham after just 31 seconds 🤯 pic.twitter.com/LrkYxOReFB.

It was Palmer who was crucial to the second for Rogers, made by Maxence Lacroix on his debut. Palmer stroked in the third on 49 minutes with the easy confidence of a man in form.

A goal for Morgan Rogers on his Chelsea debut! 🔵 pic.twitter.com/hphe8y077v.

It has been revealed that "Cole Palmer back to his best!"Palmer has scored to double Chelsea's lead! 🥶 pic.twitter.com/zo6e0Vdcgq.

Industry observers note that “I am very happy for Cole,” Alonso mentioned. “I have really enjoyed seeing him play with the dynamism and the freedom and the responsibility... when Cole feels this way we have a better team and a better Cole.”.

Sources indicate that palmer makes it look very easy in this form, capable of switching the direction of play a beat before anyone else spots the opportunity. He and his old Manchester City academy friend Rogers came off before the end, Palmer having demonstrated some discomfort chasing a ball. Asked afterwards how ready he felt, Palmer responded in kind. “Did you not watch the game? I’m only joking, I’m ready... it was a difficult season with injuries and whatnot, but through the summer and since I’ve been back I’ve worked extra hard.”.

If there was an attacker to compare with him on the other side it was King, who looks even better. The 19-year-old was way ahead of Arbeloa’s two young Real Madrid imports. García toiled away and took his chance, but César Palacios struggled for any impact in a position tucked in on the left. Oscar Bobb and King gave Fulham some edge but the concern, as ever, will be where Fulham get their goals.

In a recent development, arbeloa pushed his full-backs high and encouraged Sander Berge to drop deep to get on the ball in the first passing phase. The Norwegian delayed too long in challenging João Pedro for Chelsea’s third – backing off and allowing Palmer to overlap to receive the pass.

In a recent development, sánchez had not been the only concern for Chelsea. Back in the team, Levi Colwill misjudged a challenge on King in the first half and was relieved that the card was only yellow. Roméo Lavia took a wild swing at Calvin Bassey and was also booked. Moisés Caicedo was not fit to play. Enzo Fernández was on the bench and would come on in the second half to the kind of reception from opposition fans to which he will rapidly become familiar.

Industry observers note that there was a grin from the Argentine at those who berated him from the home stands when he returned at half-time. Fernández worked hard to transmit a general sense that the abuse did not land, although he will be relieved that the Chelsea fans were supportive. His future still feels very much in play.

It was Palmer’s subtle ball through that gave João Pedro the chance with 32 seconds of the game played. The ball came forward immediately from Lacroix’s firm header from defence. The Frenchman delivered a very accomplished assist for Rogers’s first-half goal. Before that King had equalised. There was an exchange with Timothy Castagne, and King looked up just inside the box and decided to have a swing at it. Sánchez was close enough to grasp the ball and somehow failed to do so.

Sánchez would later push a Castagne shot in the direction of García, who stooped and nodded the ball over the goalkeeper after Palmer had scored Chelsea’s third. This second error was unfortunate, but it is the kind of thing that happens to a goalkeeper as erratic as the one for whom Chelsea’s hierarchy seem to have such patience.

Recent findings suggest that “We concede goals in the first minute, the end of the first half and the beginning of the second half and there are not worse moments to concede. But we highlighted character and personality and I am very proud of how my players responded. We deserved a little bit more but football is not about what you deserve, it is about what you take. If you lose against a team like Chelsea they [should] have to do a little bit more. For me, they are easy goals for them and mistakes we cannot make. We need to improve and be more ready in the first minute, that is for sure.

“We are on our way and we will keep improving. The first thing I want to see is a competitive team. We were tonight, we tried our best and tried to play our football against a team like Chelsea, which is not easy. I believe in them and I believe in young players. I think they have the energy and ambition I want and they fit in the way I play. Josh King is absolutely amazing. I am really happy with him. Gonzalo [Garcia] scored and Cesar [Palacios] did well. I think they need a bit more time but they are doing great and making an impact already.”.

"We need to help them, not to rely everything on them" Xabi Alonso speaking about Chelsea's 'special' front three 🔵 pic.twitter.com/JnSBoNexF4.

"Arsenal DON'T win the league if they have Ramsdale and not Raya" 🧤@Carra23 and @GNev2 think that upgrading the goalkeeper position could be the 'last piece' for Chelsea 🧩 pic.twitter.com/UBzMCFmxpp.

"You can see in his eyes, he's ready to prove people wrong""Best player on the pitch by a mile" 👏Morgan Rogers reacts to his debut and the performance of Cole Palmer pic.twitter.com/M7JKk1MQ8U.

"How ready are you?""Did you not watch the game?" 😅Cole Palmer claims he is 'hungry' and ready to get back to his best! pic.twitter.com/xpg5zJl9k0.

2 - Cole Palmer tonight vs Fulham:1 goal1 assist5 dribbles completed5 shots3 chances created7 ball recoveries10 duels wonHe was only the second player on record since 2006-07 to record all of these numbers in a Premier League game.Cold. pic.twitter.com/uW4YPeHNnD.

It has been revealed that “There were things to really like. On paper, that front three [for Chelsea] is sensational. It really is. It looked it in the game. I think Joao Pedro is fantastic. [Morgan] Rogers’ first game, what a start. But when you think of him, [Cole] Palmer and Pedro; that is as good as anything in the Premier League right now.

Sources indicate that “But I do think concerns defensively. They conceded a couple of goals and you look at the goalkeeper. They have to sort the goalkeeper issue out because it is going to come back to haunt them this season, as it did tonight.”.

It has been revealed that “The attacking play, Cole Palmer was sensational. If you talk about Cole Palmer getting back to his best you have got a £120m-£125m player there. [Morgan] Rogers getting a goal. Those two being electric with Joao Pedro up front. The front three were brilliant tonight. One of the best things I have seen this weekend.

“They have added an experience player at centre-back, centre midfield and centre forward. I do not know if Emi Martinez is available or not but someone like that needs to come in at Chelsea, because that will undermine everything they do. The positives for Fulham came from the encouragement [Robert] Sanchez gave them with the goals. The goals were both mistakes. It is a problem.”.

According to recent reports, the final whistle is blown at Craven Cottage and Chelsea hold on to win 3-2 to give Xabi Alonso a win in his first game in charge. Alvaro Arbeloa’s first game as Fulham boss ends in defeat. An absorbing west London derby.

Garcia throws himself to the ground as Sessegnon sends in a cross but that is never going to be a penalty.

Pedro has the ball in the back of the Fulham net but Quenda was offside in the build-up. A quick VAR check proves so.

There will be four added minutes.

Industry observers note that surely there is another goal in this one? It is a surprise there has not been since Garcia got a goal back for Fulham.

The latest booking of the game goes the way of Castagne, who cynically trips Colwill.

Sources indicate that sessegnon is played in down the left channel and flicks it past Acheampong inside the Chelsea penalty area. Sessegnon gets his shot away from a narrow angle and it is straight at Sanchez.

Robinson just has to lift it over Sanchez from the edge of the box but his effort goes wide. Fulham should be on level terms.

Sources indicate that this is a very open, end-to-end game and you would fully expect more goals in this one. I would be very surprised if this one ended 3-2. Both defences are looking leaky.

Fulham are going to make their substitution of the night as Charles comes on for his debut having signed from Southampton, replacing Bobb.

Two former Liverpool, Real Madrid and Spain teammates go head-to-head in the dugouts at Craven Cottage as Fulham host Chelsea in a west London derby to round out the opening weekend of the new Premier League season. Alvaro Arbeloa and Xabi Alonso were teammates at Liverpool, Real Madrid and Spain and both had stints as Real Madrid manager last season but have new homes in London. Arbeloa has replaced Marco Silva, who is now at Benfica, whilst Alonso is Liam Rosenior’s permanent replacement. This is the first time a manager’s Premier League debut has come against someone he also played alongside in the competition.

Industry observers note that “I know Alonso well because I have watched so many games of his teams,” Arbeloa said. “We have to be ready, and if we want to beat them we will have to play very well. I spoke to Xabi a few days ago. But not about football; both of our families are coming to London, and we are very good friends, until Monday night [tonight]. We will be there on the touchline, so close for 90 minutes, and we will give everything for our clubs. For those 90 minutes, we are not friends.”.

Industry observers note that arbeloa has gone back to his former club to add a couple of players in the shape of Gonzalo Garcia and Cesar Palacios. The opening weekend has not served Fulham well of late; they have won just one of their last six Premier League opening weekend fixtures. They concluded their pre-season with a 1-0 win over Stuttgart.

Sources indicate that chelsea have been very active in the transfer market this summer, breaking the British transfer record to sign Morgan Rogers from Aston Villa as well as adding experience through the likes of Jordan Henderson and Danny Welbeck, whilst the likes of Marc Cucurella, Andrey Santos and Trevoh Chalobah have moved on. They finished off their pre-season with a 3-1 victory over Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge just over a week ago.

“We feel ready,” Alonso stated. “We have prepared the whole pre-season with some players from the first day, other ones coming later, but the desire, the ambition, the hunger to start the Premier League is already in the building each training [session] and we are looking forward to it.”.

Enzo Fernandez has been strongly linked with a move away this summer, with Manchester City’s interest well-known.

Recent findings suggest that “Enzo is a Chelsea player,” Alonso added. “He is a top, top player. He is training really well since he started 10 days ago with the team, very integrated. We are happy with him and he is getting ready for Monday. He is training really well, good attitude and that is what we want. He is trying his best to prepare for the kick-off of the Premier League.”.

According to recent reports, these sides finished on the same number of points (52) last season, with Chelsea finishing ahead on goal difference. It was one win apiece for each club in the two Premier League meetings last season. Nearly a year ago, Chelsea won 2-0 at Stamford Bridge whilst Fulham won 2-1 in this fixture at Craven Cottage back in January. Chelsea have won six of the past eight Premier League meetings at Craven Cottage.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Lewis Blain | 25 Nov 2026 07:10.

Real Madrid produced a sensational second-half comeback to beat PSV Eindhoven 5-1 in the Champions League on Tuesday evening, with England star Jude Bellingham proving instrumental after being introduced at half-time.

Industry observers note that jose Mourinho's side were trailing 1-0 at the interval following Ivan Perisic's penalty, but Federico Valverde restored parity before the 23-year-old produced a spectacular volley to put Los Blancos ahead. Kylian Mbappe scored twice, and Vinicius Junior added a fifth to complete the turnaround.

Bellingham's influence attracted widespread praise from the Spanish media, with several publications describing him as the decisive figure in Madrid's transformation.

His 45-minute contribution included a goal, an assist and a series of impressive individual statistics.

AS were particularly impressed, publishing the headline "Bellingham: lo cambio todo" - 'Bellingham changed everything'.

Manu de Juan highlighted how the England international reorganised Madrid's midfield, allowing Arda Guler to operate deeper and giving the hosts greater control and attacking momentum. AS also praised his spectacular volley for the 2-1 lead and his subsequent assist for Vinicius.

El Pais delivered perhaps the most glowing assessment, publishing the headline "El esplendor deslumbrante de Bellingham impulsa la goleada del Madrid al PSV" - Bellingham's 'dazzling brilliance' drives Madrid's thrashing of PSV.

Recent findings suggest that david Alvarez argued that Madrid's first-half performance had been lifeless and directionless, with Bellingham's introduction restoring clarity, composure and quality. His spectacular volley was described as a beautiful and devastating goal, with the newspaper suggesting the Englishman's arrival completely transformed the contest.

Mundo Deportivo labelled Bellingham a "superestrella" - 'superstar' - and suggested that he is right now Madrid's best player, while highlighting how his introduction changed the game.

Industry observers note that elDesmarque were equally enthusiastic, awarding the midfielder 9/10 and naming him their MVP. They highlighted his immediate influence, spectacular goal and assist for Vinicius, describing his 45 minutes as an outstanding exhibition.

Recent findings suggest that real Madrid-focused publications Defensa Central and madridistaReal went even further, awarding him 10/10 and 9.5/10 respectively. Both considered his introduction the turning point in Madrid's victory.

Spanish radio station Cadena SER also marvelled at his volley, with several commentators comparing the technical brilliance of the finish to something Zinedine Zidane might have produced - 'It's like Zizou,' one remarked.

Mourinho was equally impressed, describing the England international's performance as "absolutamente devastador" - 'absolutely devastating'.

Recent findings suggest that the Portuguese coach explained that he had initially considered leaving Bellingham out to protect him from fatigue, believing Madrid could win without him. However, he admitted that having the midfielder available from the bench proved decisive.

Mourinho also described Bellingham as a different type of player who provided something Madrid had been missing during the opening 45 minutes.

The statistics underline why the praise was justified. Despite playing just 45 minutes, Bellingham registered one goal, one assist and created three chances. According to Sofascore, he also completed 100% of his attempted dribbles, won all of his tackles and claimed 75% of his duels.

His influence extended beyond the spectacular finish, with his movement between the lines helping Madrid establish control and create opportunities for their forwards.

There is little doubt that Bellingham was the defining figure in Madrid's comeback - while Mourinho's triple half-time substitution and improved collective pressing also played important roles, the Englishman's ability to bring structure, energy and creativity to the midfield was particularly striking.

Receiving such glowing praise from the Spanish media and his manager after just 45 minutes illustrates the level Bellingham can reach when operating at his best. His goal may have been the highlight, but it was his all-round contribution that made this one of his most impressive performances of the season.

IL MILAN INSISTE PER ALEJANDRO BALDE: I ROSSONERI POSSONO GIOCARSI LA CARTA JORGE MENDES. JUAN MIRANDA, PARTITA APERTA SUL RINNOVO. IL BOLOGNA S'È CAUTELATO FINO AL 2028. Carlos Augusto ha rinnovato il proprio contratto con l’Inter. Il club nerazzurro ha infatti reso noto di aver raggiunto un accordo con il difensore brasiliano classe 1999, che sarà nerazzurro fino al 30 giugno 2031. “Inesauribile, solido, decisivo: difensore forte e veloce, esterno fisico e tecnico, minaccia costante nell’area avversaria. Carlos Augusto è diventato, nel corso degli anni, un elemento chiave nello scacchiere nerazzurro: la sua duttilità lo ha reso un giocatore fondamentale, capace di ricoprire nel migliore dei modi il ruolo di braccetto sinistro nella difesa a tre e quello di esterno a tutta fascia. Capacità con cui ha contribuito ai recenti successi dell’Inter, con cui è pronto a scrivere nuovi, entusiasmanti capitoli grazie al rinnovo di contratto che lo legherà al Club fino al 2031.

In a recent development, il Venezia continua il percorso di consolidamento e raggiunge l'accordo con uno dei suoi punti di forza. A rinnovare il suo accordo con gli arancioneroverdi è stavolta Hainaut, diventato perno inamovibile dei lagunari. Di seguito il comunicato: "Il Venezia FC comunica di aver raggiunto un accordo per il rinnovo del contratto di Antoine Hainaut, che continuerà a vestire la maglia arancioneroverde fino al 30 giugno 2030. Arrivato in laguna nella stagione 2025/26, Hainaut, 24 anni, ha collezionato finora 52 presenze ufficiali con la maglia del Venezia FC, totalizzando 7 gol e 8 assist. Protagonista della promozione in Serie A nella stagione 2025/26, Antoine Hainaut ha condiviso con il Venezia FC un percorso di grande valore, affermandosi progressivamente come uno dei punti di riferimento della squadra".

Sources indicate that stringere i denti fino a gennaio, per poi intervenire sul mercato e rinforzare una rosa che sta facendo i conti con numerose assenze. È questa la strategia del Milan, alle prese con un'emergenza infortuni che condiziona le scelte di Amorim. Per questo la dirigenza rossonera sta già lavorando sottotraccia per allungare le rotazioni, individuando nella fascia sinistra una delle principali priorità. Il nome che stuzzica maggiormente l'interesse del Diavolo, scrive il Corriere dello Sport, è quello di Alejandro Balde. Il laterale spagnolo, classe 2003, potrebbe lasciare il Barcellona già nella finestra invernale e il suo agente Jorge Mendes sarebbe al lavoro per valutare le possibili opportunità. La valutazione dei blaugrana si aggira intorno ai 50 milioni di euro, mentre l'ingaggio del giocatore è di circa 5 milioni annui. A favorire l'operazione potrebbe essere lo scarso impiego del terzino, che finora ha collezionato appena tre presenze in campionato, senza mai completare una partita. Una situazione che non soddisfa le aspettative del giocatore e che potrebbe spingerlo a cercare maggiore spazio altrove. Il Milan starebbe valutando la formula del prestito oneroso con diritto di riscatto, eventualmente trasformabile in obbligo al verificarsi di determinate condizioni. La concorrenza, però, non manca visto che anche la Juventus, la Roma e diversi club stranieri seguono con attenzione l'evoluzione della situazione.

It has been revealed that juan Miranda ha probabilmente trovato in Raffaele Palladino l'allenatore capace più di tutti gli altri di esaltare le sue caratteristiche. Da quando il manager di Mugnano di Napoli s'è insediato a Casteldebole, il laterale spagnolo ha sfornato assist a raffica. Ben quattro decisivi nelle quattro sfide tra il 17 e il 31 ottobre. Miranda contro il Parma ha poi rimediato un infortunio al bicipite femorale della coscia sinistra, un infortunio che l'ha costretto a saltare la sfida contro l'Udinese e quasi certamente lo costringerà a saltare anche la prossima contro il Venezia. Nel frattempo però tiene banco la questione rinnovo di contratto. "Ci stiamo approcciando. Abbiamo parlato con i suoi agenti, vediamo come procede", ha dichiarato il direttore sportivo rossoblù Marco Di Vaio a margine della sfida contro l'Udinese su un nuovo accordo da raggiungere col laterale di Olivares che il Bologna ha ingaggiato a parametro zero nell'estate 2024. In quell'occasione, Miranda ha sottoscritto un contratto di tre anni col Bologna con opzione per la quarta stagione, un'opzione che il club emiliano ha già esercitato estendendo così il contratto fino al 30 giugno 2028. Ma cosa ci sarà nel suo futuro? Miranda a Bologna si trova bene e un rinnovo del contratto per una ulteriore stagione o fino al 2030 è una possibilità. Allo stesso tempo, diverse big si stanno interessando a un giocatore che oggi è uno dei migliori laterali mancini della nostra Serie A. Sulle sue tracce soprattutto Milan e Juventus, due club che soprattutto in vista della prossima stagione cercano nuove garanzie per quella zona di campo. E Miranda lo sarebbe: lo confermano i numeri e le prestazioni di questa prima parte di stagione.

It has been revealed that nonostante le tante difficoltà riscontrate in questa prima parte di stagione nel ruolo al Milan di vice Goncalo Ramos, mezza Serie A continua ad avere i riflettori puntati sul baby talento Francesco Camarda. Blindato in estate da Amorim in rossonero, l'attaccante classe 2008 non si è dimostrato all'altezza di certi palcoscenici ed è per questo che la dirigenza sta studiando il giusto percorso per consentirgli una crescita ben diversa da quella vissuta a Lecce, dove Camarda si ritrovò immerso in uno degli ambienti più complessi per mettersi in mostra e guadagnare fiducia. Come detto, però, il Wonderkid di Via Aldo Rossi continua ad ad accrescere la lista degli estimatori, a cui si sarebbe aggiunto pure il Torino. Escluso Che Adams, il cui rendimento continua ad essere una costante, in casa granata l'inizio di questa stagione ha messo in luce una serie di evidenti problemi nel trovare la via del gol. Anche due pilastri come Simeone e Vlasic sembrano aver smarrito la brillantezza della scorsa stagione ed è per questo che il ds Petrachi, molto attento nella valorizzazione dei giovani italiani (vedasi gli acquisti dei vari Mascardi, Comuzzo e Fortini), avrebbe messo nel mirino, tra gli altri, proprio Francesco Camarda. Dalla loro parte i granata hanno un importante asso nella manica da potersi giocare, visto che al Filadelfia Camarda ritroverebbe Ignazio Abate. Fu quest'ultimo a lanciarlo nel 2023, a soli 15 anni, in Primavera, dove il 2008 si impose come uno degli attaccanti più interessanti del panorama giovanile italiano e non solo. La lista delle pretendenti però è lunga e se il Torino vorrà accaparrarselo dovrà battere una concorrenza feroce. In Serie A Camarda è finito anche sui taccuini di Udinese, Genoa, Cagliari - dove potrebbe essere legato a Paul Mendy, che piace al Milan -, oltre che a ad una serie di club esteri e di Serie B, Sampdoria su tutti.

It has been revealed that il Napoli dovrà aumentare sensibilmente la propria offerta per arrivare ad Agustín Giay. Il terzino destro argentino del Palmeiras, già finito nel mirino del direttore sportivo Giovanni Manna nelle precedenti sessioni di mercato, continua a essere un profilo seguito dagli azzurri. Ma la strada per portarlo in Italia si presenta tutt'altro che semplice. Secondo quanto riportato da Globo.com, infatti, il club brasiliano ha fissato a 20 milioni di euro la cifra minima per prendere in considerazione una proposta relativa al cartellino del classe 2004. Una valutazione che arriva anche alla luce dell'ultimo tentativo del Napoli. Nel corso della precedente finestra di mercato, la società partenopea aveva provato ad acquistare il giocatore mettendo sul piatto circa 14 milioni di euro. Una proposta superiore al doppio dell'investimento effettuato dal Palmeiras per strapparlo al San Lorenzo nell'estate 2024, ma comunque insufficiente per convincere la dirigenza verdeoro. Il club brasiliano ha deciso di non privarsi del difensore, puntando sulla sua ulteriore crescita. Nel frattempo, la posizione del Palmeiras si è ulteriormente rafforzata. Il club ha infatti ufficializzato il rinnovo contrattuale di Giay fino al 2031, allungando di un anno il precedente accordo.

Sources indicate that MAURO ICARDI PER RIMPIAZZARE L'INFORTUNATO KANE? IL BAYERN PENSA A UN RINFORZO OFFENSIVO. MILITO HA SCELTO: VUOLE MUSSO AL RACING, LO HA GIÀ CONTATTATO. LA SITUAZIONE ALL'ATLETICO MADRID.

Il futuro di Mauro Icardi resta ancora tutto da definire. Dopo la fine della sua esperienza al Galatasaray, il centravanti argentino non ha ancora trovato una nuova sistemazione e attende un’opportunità per tornare protagonista. Con l’avvicinarsi della finestra invernale di mercato, dalla Germania è emersa un’ipotesi suggestiva: il Bayern Monaco potrebbe valutare il suo profilo. Secondo quanto riportato dalla Bild, il club tedesco potrebbe prendere in considerazione un attaccante esperto come Icardi per fronteggiare l’assenza di Harry Kane, fermato da un infortunio che lo terrà lontano dai campi per diversi mesi. La testata tedesca ha sottolineato come il Bayern non debba necessariamente puntare su un investimento oneroso, ma possa orientarsi verso una soluzione temporanea e a basso rischio. Il riferimento è alla strategia adottata nel 2020 con Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting, arrivato a parametro zero con un contratto annuale come alternativa a Robert Lewandowski. Un’operazione nata come semplice copertura e rivelatasi poi estremamente efficace.

Il Racing, che ha attraversato un 2026 da dimenticare e ha concluso la propria stagione molto prima di quanto desiderato, pensa già al 2027. La dirigenza, guidata da Diego Milito, cerca innanzitutto di risolvere chi sarà il nuovo allenatore, ma sul mercato punterebbe un sogno: Juan Musso. Secondo quanto rivelato da TyC Sports, i dirigenti dell'Academia hanno già contattato il portiere ex Atalanta, vicecampione del mondo con la Nazionale Argentina e attuale calciatore dell'Atletico Madrid. Il Racing vorrebbe incoronarlo come nuovo punto di riferimento della squadra, mentre oggi, a 32 anni, è la riserva di Jan Oblak nei colchoneros. Di fatto, non ha ancora potuto giocare ancora questa stagione e gli resta un anno e mezzo di contratto con il club madrileno (scade il 30 giugno 2028). Il suo possibile ritorno al Racing dipende esclusivamente dalla volontà del giocatore e dalle trattative che potrà portare avanti con l'Atletico. Il suo presente - da riserva - nella Nazionale Argentina potrebbe anche pesare nella sua decisione di restare in Europa o tornare all'Academia dopo quasi nove anni. Chissà se il presidente Milito in persona servirà a smuovere Musso da Madrid.

Sources indicate that dundee manager Steven Pressley is nothing if not honest. Having taken full responsibility for his team’s 8-0 thrashing by Hearts on Saturday, he now admits that the experience left him wanting to ‘crawl under a rock and hide’.

You won’t hear him writing it off as a ‘bad day at the office’ or branding it a freak result from which he and his players would promptly move on. Dundee’s heaviest-ever home defeat in the league was an indignity that really hit their popular manager. And hit him hard.

Recent findings suggest that ‘It’s been a difficult 24-48 hours,’ stated Pressley. ‘There’s been a lot of hurt, a lot of embarrassment. As you can imagine, at times I’ve wanted to crawl under a rock and hide.

Industry observers note that ‘It’s difficult on the back of such a disappointing result. But I will say this: I suffer a lot from vulnerability at times, but for some reason during difficult moments I seem to find strength from somewhere.

According to recent reports, ‘I don’t know if it’s from my family, from messages that I’ve received, from my reading. But I’ve had to show strength. I have to support the players. I have to make sure we navigate our way out of what was a really embarrassing moment.

Sources indicate that ‘We had a good meeting yesterday. We chatted a lot about the various aspects, and hopefully we can start responding to the disappointment.’.

Dundee boss Steven Pressley claims he felt hurt and embarrassed after losing 8-0 to Hearts.

Defender Ryan Astley struggles to take in Dundee's heaviest-ever home defeat in the league.

Sources indicate that that process starts tomorrow night against Hibs, who suffered a humiliation of their own when they lost 4-0 at home to Dundee United on Saturday. Pressley states the immediate objective for his team is to go there with a better attitude than they have shown lately.

Industry observers note that he had feared a setback coming for Dundee – ‘not 8-0 but a disappointing performance’ – because he had ‘sensed a little bit of subconscious complacency’. He felt his team had been over-hyped by outsiders on the back of a start to the season in which they won five of their 12 matches before the international break.

Industry observers note that ‘We’re nowhere near the levels that people keep telling us we are,’ he said. ‘We’re not a good enough team not to do the hard yards. Our whole strength has been built on the cohesion of the team, the unity of the team, the aggressiveness of the team.

Sources indicate that ‘And I think what Saturday did highlight is exactly what I’ve been saying. If we get lazy on the hard yards, we’re a very vulnerable team. We have to be at our absolute best to get results.’.

He hopes the Hearts game will be ‘a reset moment’ that eventually helps his players to improve, but there are no guarantees from Pressley that they will shake it off at Easter Road tomorrow.

In a recent development, asked if he expected a positive response from them, he remarked: ‘I don’t know. I know that they’re hurting. I know that they want to respond in the best possible way. That part I don’t question. I know how much it’s affected them.

It has been revealed that ‘But we’ve not had a lot of time. I just hope we can bring some pride back to the football club with the right type of performance.’.

The good news for Dundee is that they are up against a team who have been hopeless in their own stadium recently. Second-bottom Hibs have lost nine of their last ten Premiership games at Easter Road and haven’t taken three points there since early April.

Supporters turned on the Edinburgh side after the defeat by Dundee United, but Hibs midfielder Jamie McGrath has dismissed the idea that he and his team-mates don’t enjoy playing in their own ground.

Jamie McGrath was in the Hibs side that suffered another defeat at Easter Road on Saturday.

According to recent reports, ‘Personally, I always like playing at home,’ said McGrath. ‘I love the pitch, I love the stadium. It’s a big open pitch, which I think should suit us. But for whatever reason, so far this season we haven’t been able to capitalise on playing at home.

‘It’s hard to put your finger on one certain thing. Maybe just being more decisive in both boxes or probably conceding goals at crucial times in the game, like after five minutes on Saturday, we just give ourselves a bit of a mountain to climb.’.

It looked like Marink Reedijk’s side had turned the corner when they followed up a rousing victory over city rivals Hearts in the Premier Sports Cup semi-final with a 4-0 win at Aberdeen in their last game before the international break.

It has been revealed that so McGrath is hoping Saturday’s aberration was a blip. ‘We’ve been on a decent run the last month and probably the international break came at a tricky time for us. We were just kind of building momentum and had two good wins back-to-back against two good teams. It’s frustrating not to build on that.’.

McGrath is unfazed by Hibs’ lowly league position and senses a chance to change that with three matches in the space of nine days against other sides in the bottom six.

According to recent reports, ‘It’s not something that we’re concerned about at the minute. It’s obviously not where we want to be. We want to try to get closer to that top six and this two-week period is quite crucial. If you put a little run together, you can boost yourself right up the league.’.

AC Milan put in one of their best performances under Ruben Amorim so far to sweep aside Frosinone at San Siro.
